articles.summary: RICHMOND, Va., April 29, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- The Board of Directors of The Brink’s Company (NYSE:BCO) today declared a regular quarterly dividend of $0.255 per share on the Company’s common stock. The dividend is payable on June 1, 2026, to shareholders of record as of May 18, 2026.
